description: Exactly ONE compact horizontal pixel art boss-presence HUD FRAME, 256x64 pixels. Follow the concept image layout and outer panel proportions closely. A drowned office corridor in the abyss. Teal painted office metal and rusted copper pipe joints form the outer frame, four small rivets, subtle yellow caution-stripe corners, faint deep-sea cyan lights. No readable paperwork or writing. Claustrophobic underwater mystery. Keep a generous 48-pixel-high rectangular interior; never compress it to a thin health bar. The reference fish, if present, is only a palette and motif reference: leave the left badge interior EMPTY for an existing sprite. Match this usable layout: outer border entirely within x2..253,y2..61; thick ornamental rim only at edges; empty dark left badge x10..47,y11..52; large blank dark LABEL AREA x54..242,y11..32; separate empty black PROGRESS TROUGH x54..242,y39..49. The label area must be visibly taller than the trough. Do not fill the trough. Every inner area stays dark, blank, simple and unobstructed. Decorate only the outer rim with the region motifs. Crisp square pixels, strong dark outline, three shades per material, cozy detailed 16-bit fishing RPG. All four edges and corner ornaments fully visible, transparent exterior. No text, no letters, no numerals, no glyphs, no tick marks, no filled progress, no fish body, no people, no background scene, no blurred gradients. One frame only.
color_palette: deep teal, oxidized copper, dark navy, restrained caution yellow, dim cyan
